finding.title: ReturnTo.after_sign_in_path accepts any value starting with a slash, so //evil.example may redirect users off-site after sign-in.
finding.description: ReturnTo.after_sign_in_path accepts any value starting with a slash, so //evil.example may redirect users off-site after sign-in. Analyze this component only.

source_files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'return_to'

class ReturnToTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_keeps_local_path
    assert_equal '/dashboard', ReturnTo.after_sign_in_path('/dashboard')
  end
end
